 Gold Rates Today In Hyderabad On Nov. 21, 2026 
 Gold Rates Today | Hyderabad, Nov. 21: Gold rates today in Hyderabad fallen on November 21, 2026, according to the latest market listings.
 The 22-carat gold rate stands at Rs. 1,14,650 per 10 grams with a fall of Rs. 450. Meanwhile, 24-carat gold is priced at Rs. 1,25,080 per 10 grams with a fall of Rs. 490.
